structural_attribution.scope: Read-only attribution of one already completed software-instrumented real-suffix trace. No GPU/build/retest or product/source modifications by this reviewer. All 322 heads and all 256 primary samples retained; no favorable median selection or slow-sample exclusion.

method.grouping: Sort all GPU kernel records by start; each head begins a group through the next head start (last group through remaining kernels). Each group contains one head, optional BF16-to-F32 Cast, and exactly four eager CUB kernels. A same-correlation captured4096B D2D Copy belongs to that graph before its head. The first4B D2H after the final CUB kernel is the run endpoint; later verification reads are excluded.
method.arm_classification: Cast present iff float SingleRowArgInput and float ArgValue appear. Cast absent iff BF16 SingleRowArgInput and BF16 ArgValue appear. Both classifiers and source execution order must agree.
method.phase_selection: Heads0..1 are two cold checks;2..65 are64 warm runs (32 per arm);66..321 map one-to-one to the256 saved primary ABBA samples. No warmup/cold sample is pooled into primary.
method.host_envelope: cudaGraphLaunch runtime API start through associated first4B cuMemcpyDtoH runtime API end; actual saved profiled wall surrounds complete public run. Remaining wall-minus-envelope includes surrounding host control/measurement, not unaccounted model work.
method.gap_semantics: post-head idle gaps and last-kernel-to-token-copy gaps are device timeline intervals that can include host/runtime scheduling, completion notification and GPU/driver delays. They are not proven pure CPU waste or reclaimable wall savings.
method.statistics: All sample distributions include n/mean/median/p90/p99/min/max. Percentiles linearly interpolate sorted samples. Medians of components are not additive.

structure.head_symbol: std::enable_if<!T7, void>::type internal::gemvx::kernel<int, int, __nv_bfloat16, __nv_bfloat16, __nv_bfloat16, float, (bool)0, (bool)1, (bool)1, (bool)0, (int)6, (bool)0, cublasGemvParamsEx<int, cublasGemvTensorStridedBatched<const __nv_bfloat16>, cublasGemvTensorStridedBatched<const __nv_bfloat16>, cublasGemvTensorStridedBatched<__nv_bfloat16>, float>>(T13)

interpretation: The removed Cast is real and costs median3.040us in this trace. Direct CUB total median9.920us versus10.240us for float; direct does not reveal a slower CUB kernel chain here.

Post-head device span median falls18.720us to15.296us (mean18.939773 to15.491461us), consistent with eliminating the Cast; this narrow effect is measurable structurally within the trace but is not a throughput acceptance.

Head duration dominates: cast/direct medians2105.804/2100.7475us while means2157.742422/2178.815109us. The common symbol and geometry have broad variable tails. This trace alone cannot identify whether clocks, memory scheduling, destination address/arena placement, or other system behavior caused that variation.

Profiled primary direct wall median is lower by5.550us, but its mean is higher by14.142188us. Mean decomposition: head+21.072688us, post-head span-3.448313us, surrounding remainder-3.482188us. Do not add median component differences or discard tails to select a positive conclusion.

Completion/host-read intervals also vary: last-kernel-to-token-device-start medians27.6795/29.1200us and maxima308.093/166.590us for cast/direct. They can exceed the approximately3us Cast saving; these intervals are not evidence that skipping legal waits is safe.

Independent unprofiled process paired medians have mixed signs (-6.2,-0.55,+5.0us for cast-minus-direct). Ordinary independent arm medians all favor direct, but all three direct means are higher. Thus neither favorite summary establishes a consistent net benefit or no-regression.

The trace explains how a real small conversion saving can coexist with an inconsistent total result. It does not establish a specific persistent regression cause, a statistical speedup, equivalence of full-model allocator/cache behavior, DRAM byte savings, or a full-model throughput win.
